title: Checkpoint Inhibitor Resistance Mediated by PD-L1 Upregulation
text: Immune checkpoint inhibitors have transformed oncology, yet acquired drug resistance remains a major obstacle. We show that sustained interferon-gamma exposure drives PD-L1 upregulation on tumor cells, enabling immune evasion. In contrast to previous studies attributing resistance solely to T-cell exhaustion, our data point to a tumor-intrinsic mechanism. Combination strategies targeting both PD-L1 and the tumor microenvironment are warranted. It remains to be determined whether epigenetic modifiers can durably reverse PD-L1 overexpression.
